description: This file defines multiple interfaces related to event data generation and stream control within the Orleans framework, specifically for testing and managing event data streams in Azure Event Hubs. It includes interfaces for data generators, stream controllers, and counters, along with an internal implementation of a counter.

classes.name: IntCounter
classes.description: Internal implementation of IIntCounter that maintains a simple integer counter with increment functionality.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to read a specified maximum number of events, outputting the events as an enumerable collection.

methods.name: AddDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Configures a data generator for a specific stream identified by streamId.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops production of events for a specified stream.

methods.name: SequenceNumberCounter
methods.description: Property to set the sequence number counter for a stream data generator.

methods.name: StreamId
methods.description: Property providing the identifier for the data stream.

methods.name: ShouldProduce
methods.description: Property that indicates whether the data generator should produce data.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property returning the current value of the integer counter.

methods.name: Increment
methods.description: Method to increment the counter value by one.
